_doc: The report's per-viewer preferences the Mac app keeps across relaunches (R89). The SPA posts each change as {type: 'report-pref', key, value}; BridgeHandler saves it in UserDefaults and seeds every new web view's localStorage. A key matches if it is listed or starts with a listed prefix (and is at most max_key_length long). Asserted by frontend/src/utils/nativePrefs.test.ts (MIRRORED_PREF_KEYS) and desktop/Bristlenose/BristlenoseTests/ReportPrefsMirrorTests.swift (BridgeHandler.reportPrefKeys): a key added on one side only fails one of the two.
